Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade

5.name: Echoing Vigor

6.name: Shooting Star

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.

1.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff6149|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1336|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Rune of Displacement
2.description:
Devise a discharging rune under an enemy. After |cffffff2|r seconds the rune pulses, pulling in foes between 2 to 10 meters and etching them with scrawled glyphs that deal |cffffff18900|r Magic Damage over |cffffff18|r seconds.

An ally near the initial target can activate the Runebreak synergy, dealing |cffffff11906|r Frost Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

3.name: Inspired Scholarship
3.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3906|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

4.name: Relentless Focus
4.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff17459|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

5.name: Concealed Weapon
5.description:
Slash an enemy, dealing |cffffff10669|r Magic Damage. 

If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance.

When you leave Sneak or invisibility while in combat, increase your damage done with this ability by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff15|r seconds.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

6.name: Soul Harvest
6.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff15519|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
